C9000178.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 178 (Deterministic nonbipartite Ramanujan graphs in every fixed degree.; papers: Deterministic nonbipartite Ramanujan graphs in every fixed degree; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_MAIN178.statement: For each fixed d >= 3, the manuscript constructs, deterministically in polynomial bit complexity, a simple d-regular graph of every sufficiently large even order with all nonconstant eigenvalues strictly between -2 sqrt(d-1) and 2 sqrt(d-1). This main theorem is not settled by the current bounded audit.

C_OTHER_CONSTRUCTION178.statement: The structural, trace, cleanup, boundary, exact-repair, and bit-complexity obligations needed for thm:main, other than the order-uniform high-moment implication, hold with compatible constants. These are outside this mission and remain open.

C_HM_UNIFORM.statement: Under the source-local upstream kernel, low-square, signed-mean, and linearization estimates, every fixed even p >= 4 has an early-phase weighted drift bound with C_star = 64 + 8192 H independent of p and deterministic error budgets of total o(1). H is fixed before p; the size threshold is chosen after p.

C_HM_KERNEL_INPUT.statement: The source-local path kernels have squared rows and cubic columns bounded by constants fixed before p, entry supremum 1+o(1), fixed-threshold locality, and the formal-tail bound stated in foundations.tex, equations original-4 through original-7.

C_HM_LOW_INPUT.statement: The current-state low-square bounds and resolvent row bound imply normalized row, diagonal, and fixed-radius near-pair second moments at most n^(-beta), for beta fixed before p.

C_HM_MEAN_INPUT.statement: The source-local signed conditional mean, residual second moment and supremum, and conditional diagonal middle-coefficient estimate original-22 and original-29 through original-32 hold under the stated common bootstrap assumptions.

C_HM_WORDS.statement: For pure-swap index words with no off-diagonal topology factor and at most one intermediate error, the same-end exception and the topology-only distinct-end classification hold for every word length, by a complete finite-state induction.

C_HM_MIXED.statement: All intermediate Taylor powers and all mixed retained pure powers have an n^(-delta_p)/l gain under the explicit kernel and low-square inputs; first-order and residual budgets have total o(1).

C_HM_PAIR.statement: Under the explicit inputs, the independent-pair family's own nonsummable pure-power coefficient is at most 4096 H h^p; diagonal-to-pair transfer is at most T_p/l^2. Constants depending on the near radius occur only in summable terms.

C_HM_DIAG.statement: Under the explicit inputs, the diagonal family's own nonsummable pure-power coefficient is at most 2048 H h^(2p); all potentially order-amplifying one-axis pure powers are pair-to-diagonal transfer at most T_p/l.

C_HM_WEIGHT.statement: For nonnegative A,T,F,D,v and l > 0, the two inequalities EF' <= (1+A/l)F+TD/l^2+v(1+F+D) and ED' <= (1+A/l)D+TF/l+v(1+F+D) imply weighted drift with coefficient A+1, fixed weight 1/(1+T), and budget T/(kappa l^2)+(1+kappa)v/kappa.
